visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large assembly of people is positioned on a vibrant green grass field in front of a grand, multi-story stone castle with distinct red-brown trim and multiple gables. The group consists of about twenty women wearing matching sleeveless light blue gowns, several men in formal dark suits, and a couple in white and black wedding attire standing beneath a white floral arch. A young child in a striped horizontal shirt runs across the lawn in the foreground while the participants shift positions and talk amongst themselves. The lighting is bright and even, cast by an overcast sky over a landscaped garden with trimmed hedges. (2) On an unspoken cue, the entire group raises their hands high and tosses handfuls of white petals or small confetti into the air, creating a dense flurry of white dots against the background. Yellow graphic overlays appear in the center of the frame. The castle remains static in the background as the crowd cheers with jubilant facial expressions, open mouths, and raised arms. The camera maintains a wide, eye-level long shot perspective throughout this celebratory action, capturing the full scale of the wedding party and the architectural environment.
